baseline_update_policy.ordinary_direction: existing exceptions may be removed but not added

limitations: The analysis is bounded to one Python module and propagates values only within one function or module scope.
Attribute name is treated as card identity only when the receiver has a configured card, record, face, or identity-bearing type proof.
Dynamic values, computed containers, reflection beyond configured getattr fields, and interprocedural return flows are outside the analysis.
The guard targets fixed identity dispatch and is not a general-purpose information-flow or privacy analysis.
